strings.name: Yukihiro Matsumoto
strings.summary: Matsumoto began Ruby alongside programming work, combining object orientation with programmer enjoyment. Development started in 1993 and public release followed in 1995. International maintainers and the Ruby Association helped sustain it; Rails, created by other developers, broadened web adoption. He remained a community keynote speaker in 2026. Later releases reflect the long work of many contributors.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Created Ruby and promoted language design centered on developer experience, influencing web-application communities.

strings.highlights.h1.title: A programmer-centered language
strings.highlights.h1.text: Combined objects, iterators, exceptions and garbage collection in an expressive language.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Sustaining a community
strings.highlights.h2.text: Supported evolution through the Ruby Association, international conferences and shared maintenance.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Hakodate keynote
strings.timeline.t1.text: RubyKaigi’s official schedule and recording archive document his 2026 keynote participation.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Ruby 4.0 released
strings.timeline.t2.text: The project team released 4.0 with experimental Ruby Box and ZJIT among its changes.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Ruby 3.0 released
strings.timeline.t3.text: The community advanced performance, concurrency and type-related tools in version 3.0.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Ruby 2.0 released
strings.timeline.t4.text: The language’s twentieth anniversary brought version 2.0 and further language and tooling development.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Ruby Association chair
strings.timeline.t5.text: Took a role supporting language promotion and its industry community.
strings.timeline.t6.title: First public Ruby release
strings.timeline.t6.text: Posted Ruby 0.95 to Japanese newsgroups, beginning an open development and discussion community.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Began designing Ruby
strings.timeline.t7.text: After discussing object-oriented scripting with a colleague, began a language balancing expressiveness and usability.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completed Tsukuba studies
strings.timeline.t8.text: Earned a computer-science bachelor’s before gaining professional programming experience.
